messages.author: c5de8c8c086d2efe
messages.subject: ggspectro + geom with different df?
parts:
Hi there, 

I'm having a little issue with ggspectro, and wonder if its an error in my script or a limitation of the function. 
I'm trying to plot a spectrogram and then overlay in a new geom timestamps that indicate the start and end of vocalizations. 

Suppose I have: 
wav_seg - a wave array, the output of cutw()
timestamps - a df with columns: method, sig.start, sig.end, y.val:
method<fctr>     sig.start <dbl>    sig.end <dbl>   y.val <dbl>
bioacoustics     0.926724            0.929792      90
bioacoustics     0.967684            0.970752      90
bioacoustics     1.684484            1.687552       90
bioacoustics     1.916932            1.920000       90


I want to plot the following: 
seewave::ggspectro(wav_seg, f = r...@samp.rate, ovlp = 50)  + # base layer
    geom_tile(mapping = aes(fill = amplitude)) + # spectrogram
    geom_segment(data = timestamps, mapping = aes(x = sig.start, y = y.val, 
                                                 xend = sig.end, yend = y.val, 
                                                 group = method)) 
# line segments that indicate vocalization start and end times, for each of 3 methods used
The first two lines by themselves work fine: 
seewave::ggspectro(wav_seg, f = r...@samp.rate, ovlp = 50)  + # base layer
    geom_tile(mapping = aes(fill = amplitude))
And the label layer if attached to a new ggplot() base works fine:
ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = timestamps, mapping = aes(x = sig.start, y = y.val, 
                                                 xend = sig.end, yend = y.val, 
                                                 group = method)) 
... which led me to believe I didn't make an error in scripting. 

Yet the combination of the three lines returns this error: 

Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (3259): z Run `rlang::last_error()` to see where the error occurred.
12.
stop(fallback)
11.
signal_abort(cnd)
10.
abort(glue("Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data ({n}): ", glue_collapse(names(which(!good)), ", ", last = " and ")))
9.
check_aesthetics(evaled, n)
8.
f(..., self = self)
7.
l$compute_aesthetics(d, plot)
6.
f(l = layers[[i]], d = data[[i]])
5.
by_layer(function(l, d) l$compute_aesthetics(d, plot))
4.
ggplot_build.ggplot(x)
3.
ggplot_build(x)
2.
print.ggplot(x)
1.
(function (x, ...) UseMethod("print"))(x)


Any tips on resolving this? I thought it was just about specifying which aes refers to which data, but it seems there's a problem with adding geom layers with different dfs to ggspectro... 

Many thanks, 
Ava

messages.author: 44c03a0165efd08f
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] ggspectro + geom with different df?
parts:
Hi Ava,

I suspect this has to do with aesthetics defined in ggpsectro not being available in the layer with your custom data frame.

The easiest solution would be to to add "inherit.aes = FALSE" to the geom_segment(). This means that any aesthetics defined in ggspectro won't be carried into geom_segment.

Hope this helps!

Steffi

--
